arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 180 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,time,itertools,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
rng=random.Random(42)
fields=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':('size' if i<2 else 'flag'),'domain':[0,1]} for i in range(4)]
K=4;nf=4
preds=[]
for i in range(32):
    typ=rng.randrange(5)
    f=fields[rng.randrange(4)]
    if typ==0:
      preds.append({'kind':'any','field':f['name'],'op':rng.choice(['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge'] if f['type']!='flag' else ['eq','ne']),'value':rng.randrange(3)})
    elif typ==1:
      preds.append({'kind':'all','field':f['name'],'op':rng.choice(['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge'] if f['type']!='flag' else ['eq','ne']),'value':rng.randrange(3)})
    elif typ==2:
      # scale numeric ref
      preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'scale':rng.randrange(4),'ref':[rng.randrange(K),rng.choice(fields[:2])['name']]},'op':rng.choice(['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge']),'right':{'const':rng.randrange(6),'type':'size'}})
    elif typ==3:
      # sum 4 distinct refs numeric
      refs=[(rng.randrange(K),f['name']) for f in fields[:2]]
      # need distinct
      allrefs=[(s,f['name']) for s in range(K) for f in fields[:2]]
      refs=rng.sample(allrefs,4)
      preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'sum':[list(r) for r in refs]},'op':rng.choice(['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge']),'right':{'const':rng.randrange(8),'type':'size'}})
    else:
      preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[rng.randrange(K),rng.choice(fields[:2])['name']]},'op':rng.choice(['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge']),'right':{'ref':[rng.randrange(K),rng.choice(fields[:2])['name']]}})
# generate train random windows
flat_domains=[f['domain'] for s in range(K) for f in fields]
train=[]
for _ in range(10000):
 flat=list(rng.choice(d) for d in flat_domains)
 train.append([flat[s*nf:(s+1)*nf] for s in range(K)])
queries=[]
for i in range(64):
 target=[rng.randrange(K),rng.choice(fields)['name']]
 fixed=[]
 avail=[[s,f['name']] for s in range(K) for f in fields if [s,f['name']]!=target]
 for r in rng.sample(avail,rng.randrange(1,12)):
   f=next(f for f in fields if f['name']==r[1])
   fixed.append({'ref':r,'value':rng.choice(f['domain'])})
 queries.append({'target':target,'prefix':''.join(str(rng.randrange(10)) for _ in range(rng.randrange(4))),'fixed':fixed})
job={'fields':fields,'slots':K,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':[],'queries':queries}
st=time.time();res=compile_job(job);dt=time.time()-st
print('discover+decode unapproved time',dt,'rules',len(res['rules']),'answers',len(res['answers']))
# now approved up to 256 rules from rules
job['approved']=[r['clause'] for r in res['rules'][:256]]
st=time.time();res=compile_job(job);dt=time.time()-st
print('with 256 active time',dt,'rules',len(res['rules']),'answers',len(res['answers']), 'theory maybe', [a['count'] for a in res['answers'][:5]])
PY
